_about: Labelled messages for scripts/safety-eval.mjs (roadmap B2). Written for this evaluation — no real user data. Labels follow the classifier's own categories: high = suicidal or self-harm intent, a plan, or wanting to die/not be here (explicit, indirect, or obfuscated); low = distress or hopelessness without clear intent; none = ordinary venting, anger, sadness, everyday problems — including HARD NEGATIVES (negation, idiom, third-party/media mentions) that trip keyword lists. 'ambiguous' items are reported descriptively and excluded from the metrics.
